# ManagerBench: capability-level evaluation of a released Manager adapter

## TL;DR
Draft PR #9527 extends the existing ManagerBench replay with two pinned receipt adapters. The original 260 rows are byte-identical; 155 tests pass. The team has published a trained Gemma 4 E2B adapter on GitHub Releases.

![Separate metrics and evaluation pipeline](/assets/research/managerbench-capability-scorecard-2026-11-26.svg)

Figure: same reported GPU-stack comparison on 1,000 Hillstrom cases. Base values from release report, adapter values from attached aggregate receipt.

| Metric | Base | Adapter |
|---|---:|---:|
| Brier | 0.1386 | 0.1197 |
| Log loss | 1.2520 | 0.4032 |
| AUC | 0.5541 | 0.5223 |

## Methods and limitations
Implemented as optional flags on the existing CLI. Recomputed BFM02 accuracy 10/16 and regret 0.0875 from 24 rows with 16 non-ties. Hillstrom remains aggregate-only. Synthetic anomaly detection is a separate diagnostic; missing tracks explicit. No new inference, training or production deployment.

The published adapter is 94.77 MB, trained by the team for 125 QLoRA steps. We independently verified the evaluation JSON SHA-256, not the weight bytes. AUC declined; no promotion. PR remains draft.
